title: Greer warns Joe Firmage at Mars Cafe

tellings.quote: bait. He was wealthy. And I met with him at the Mars Cafe in South of Market in San Francisco way back in the 90s.

plain: In the 1990s the UFO activist Steven Greer says he met a wealthy man named Joe Firmage at the Mars Cafe in San Francisco's South of Market area and warned him. Greer describes Firmage's wealth as making him "bait", which suggests he saw a rich newcomer to the subject as a target for people who wanted to use him.
